thread.force-push: terminatr guard (force-push): force-pushing is not allowed here. Push without force; if the branch has diverged, merge instead of rewriting it, or say so in your report.
thread.push-default: terminatr guard (push-default): nothing is pushed straight to master: work lands through a pull request. Push your own branch and report; the coordinator opens the PR.
thread.worktree-only: terminatr guard (worktree-only): a thread writes only inside its worktree (/h/.terminatr/worktrees/demo/t-0001-fix). Write the file there, or say so in your report what needs changing elsewhere.
thread.delete-branch: terminatr guard (delete-branch): agents don't delete branches or worktrees; tm cleans them up once the work has merged. Leave them, and say so in your report if one is in the way.
thread.merge: terminatr guard (merge): merging is the coordinator's job in this project (merge = "coordinator"). Leave the PR open with CI green and say so in your report.
thread.credentials: terminatr guard (credentials): credential files and tokens are not read here. A tool that needs a token gets it from the secret environment the user gives threads in tm's settings; if the task needs access you don't have, say so in your report exactly what is missing.
thread.temp-folders: terminatr guard (temp-folders): other threads' temp folders are not read or written here. Keep your files in your own temp folder ($TMPDIR) or your worktree, or say so in your report.

coordinator.force-push: terminatr guard (force-push): force-pushing is not allowed here. Push without force; if the branch has diverged, merge instead of rewriting it, or ask the user.
